title: Technology overlay on phones
description: The Technology overlay (header Technologies button, the research decision, and secondary prepare mode) was laid out for a desktop: a 948 px wide four-column grid inside a 360 px screen that panned sideways with the track headers scrolled away, a research panel (skips, resources, Decline and Confirm) that took most of the height so the grid had 55 to 208 px, 30 to 38 px tall buttons and skip pills, a panel that did not fill the screen, and on a landscape phone the prepare banner squeezed the dialog to nothing. On a phone (up to 720 px wide or up to 500 px tall) the dialog now fills the screen, the four tracks stack (a track label on every card), the research panel is compact with the skips on one scrolling row and 44 px buttons, and in landscape the controls sit left with the grid on the right. Desktop is unchanged. The before shots are taken on the commit without the fix and committed; the after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BB. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Before: header Technologies, 390x844
shots.caption: Letterboxed panel with gaps above and below, a 948 px wide grid that pans sideways (only the first column and a half is visible), 38 px Close button.

shots.caption: Full-screen panel, one column, a track label on each card, a 44 px Close button, no sideways scroll.

shots.caption: Compact research bar: skips on one scrolling row, Decline and Confirm 44 px high, the grid gets 467 px and stacks into one column.
